title: Atomic Prop-Type Catalog (V4 typed-envelope catalog)
description: FROZEN catalog of V4 atomic typed-envelope ($$type/value) prop types. Grounded in SUPPLEMENT.md §B.1 and verified against elementor/modules/atomic-widgets/prop-types/. The PHP dry_run validator (WP-P03) is the AUTHORITATIVE validator; this schema is a STRUCTURAL pre-filter only — it intentionally under-constrains conditional/Union/Dependency-Manager validity (resolved PHP-side). The universal wire shape for every transformable value is {"$$type":<get_key()>,"value":<payload>,"disabled"?:true} per prop-types/concerns/has-generate.php:11-22. Two exceptions: (1) `classes` value is a BARE string array (no inner wrapping); (2) UNION members are emitted as the chosen member's own envelope (the union itself is never wrapped) per union-prop-type.php:74-96.
$comment: TS type name for the generic envelope: TypedValue (WP-F03). Each named sub-shape below maps to a TS discriminated-union member keyed on the $$type literal.

TypedValue.description: The universal atomic typed envelope. $$type MUST equal the prop type's get_key(). Pre-filter accepts any string $$type; PHP dry_run rejects unregistered keys.

Size.description: $$type:'size'. value object. unit enum is site/preset-dependent; PHP authoritative. 'auto' => size null; 'custom' => size is a string.

Dimensions.description: $$type:'dimensions'. Each side is a Size envelope. Logical (block/inline) edges, never physical.

Classes.description: $$type:'classes'. value is a BARE array of class-name strings (NO inner wrapping). Each name matches /^[a-z][a-z-_0-9]*$/i per classes-prop-type.php:22. Contains BOTH global-class ids (g-*) and local-style ids (e-<elementId>-<7hex>).

Link.description: $$type:'link'. destination is a Union(url|query); pre-filter accepts any TypedValue. tag enum ['a','button'] default 'a' per link-prop-type.php:38-50.

ImageSrc.description: $$type:'image-src'. value carries id (image-attachment-id envelope) XOR url (url envelope) — NEVER both, NEVER neither, per image-src-prop-type.php:36-44 ($has_id xor $has_url). Prefer ID-only after media.sideload_url. alt optional. NOTE: JSON Schema cannot fully express the nested-envelope XOR cheaply; this pre-filter encodes the XOR at the top of value via oneOf on presence; PHP dry_run is authoritative.

Image.description: $$type:'image'. src is an ImageSrc envelope (REQUIRED); size is a string envelope of an image-size key (init 'full').

HtmlV3.description: $$type:'html-v3'. value object. content is null OR a WRAPPED string envelope {$$type:'string',value:str}. children is a PLAIN array (NO wrapping). The rendered inner HTML is wp_kses-filtered to the INLINE-ONLY allowlist [b,i,em,u,a,del,span,strong,sup,sub,s] per html-v3-prop-type.php:82,91 — all other tags (br, mark, code, small, lists, block elements) are SILENTLY STRIPPED. Block children MUST be promoted to sibling element nodes BEFORE emission.

GlobalVariableRef.description: $$type one of global-color-variable | global-font-variable | global-size-variable. value is the variable id string (e-gv-*). All three types are FREE in 4.1.x (variables/hooks.php:48-51). Renders var(--<label>).
